BiblicalUsage: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of trembling unto all the people round about, when they shall be in the siege against Judah and Jerusalem. The word is the reeling itself, the draught that staggers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jerusalem is a cup of trembling to the nations round about, and God made her so.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
